21KM

RACE INFO

▸ Start time 3:30 AM Sunday, 17 January 2027 ▸ Cut-off time 3 hours 30 minutes (7:00 AM)

▸ Age limitation 16yo+ (as of 17 Jan 2027) ▸ Start & Finish Point 30th April Park, Le Duan Street, Saigon Ward, HCMC (Google maps)

|Race map 21KM

ⓘ The information is subject to change.

ⓘ Please note Participants who have not previously completed the Half Marathon-21km distance are strongly advised to follow a serious training program. Please note that due to the HCMC Marathon taking place in the heart of the city, you may encounter some interruptions due to traffic lights. Kindly be understanding and follow the instructions of the event staff to ensure safety during the race. At the same time, the event will inevitably have some impact on resident’s commutes. If there are any inconveniences during participation, we kindly ask for the understanding of residents and participants. Runners will not be allowed to continue after the Cut-Off time at each checkpoint under any circumstances. This is to ensure that roads can be reopened to local residents in accordance with regulations. It also helps ensure the safety of security personnel, staff, and volunteers, preventing them from working extended hours in hot weather conditions. Aid stations (water and medical) will also be closed once traffic is reopened.

WELFARE

|Race kit

(1) Official Event Singlet (2) Race BIB number & timing chip (3) Bag drop service (4) Finisher Medal (*) (5) E-certificate (6) Nutrition after the race

ⓘ Sponsored products will not be included in the Race Kit. However, you can visit our partners' booths at the Expo to collect free items or participate in their activities to receive many gifts. In order to reduce waste and paper usage, Vouchers from partners and sponsors (if any) will be converted into E-vouchers and sent to participants before the event via E-Race Guide.

|Size chart

ⓘ This size chart is intended for reference only.

ⓘ Please note Registrations completed after 11:59 PM (ICT) on 15 October 2026 will be subject to the following conditions: • Names will not be printed on the race bib (BIB); • T-shirt sizes cannot be guaranteed; • Participants will be assigned to the last starting PEN (corral). (*) Only runners who finished the course within the cut-off time (Gun Time) can be awarded a Medal.

REGISTRATION FEE

HCMC Marathon 2027 registration officially opens at 3:00 PM on 23 June 2026.

ⓘ Please note Due to space limitations at the Start & Finish area in the city center, the race will accept a limited number of participants. Registration will close once the maximum quota is reached. The registration fee is inclusive of VAT in accordance with current regulations. (*) Residents include Vietnamese citizens and foreign nationals who hold a valid residence card in Vietnam. The residence card must be valid both at the time of registration and during Race Kit collection.

RACE BIB PICK-UP

|Time & location

▸ 9:00 AM - 7:00 PM Friday, 15 Jan 2027 ▸ 9:00 AM - 6:00 PM Saturday, 16 Jan 2027 ⎯⎯⎯ 𖡡  Hoa Lu Sports Center, 2 Dinh Tien Hoang Street, Sai Gon Ward, HCMC (Google Maps)

ⓘ Race kit pick-up is not available on Sunday morning (17 Jan 2027). Please collect your BIB within the provided time.

|Required documents

▸ Original Passport or Citizen ID of the registered runner ▸ Confirmation Email showing your assigned BIB Number (this will be sent 7 days before the event) ▸ Original valid Temporary Residence Card (applicable to foreigners registered in Resident category).

E-WAIVER AGREEMENT

(1) Without exception, sending registration information via any form (registering directly on the website, sending individual registration emails, registering in groups, through our official partners) shows your consent – the contest participant, and you understand, agree, warrants and covenants to the race HCMC Marathon 2027. See details HERE. (2) Race entry fees are non-refundable under all circumstances. (3) The use of a BIB that does not belong to the registered participant is strictly prohibited. This regulation is in place to ensure proper race organization and to protect participants’ safety in case of any incidents during the race. (4) The Organizing Committee enforces a Cut-off Time for each race category after the official start. After this time, participants will not be allowed to start or continue their race, in order to ensure smooth operations and maintain a quality race experience. (5) Please help maintain public cleanliness. Waste disposal points are provided throughout 30th April Park, at water stations, and along the race course. Participants are kindly requested to dispose of trash in designated areas to help preserve a clean, green, and beautiful city environment. (6) After the Cut-off Time, shuttle vehicles arranged will transport participants back. Participants who choose not to board these vehicles will not receive any further support. The race course will then be cleared and reopened for public traffic.

CHANGE CATEGORY & BIB TRANSFER

|CONDITIONS

Participants can change the category or transfer their race entries once until 11:59 PM (ICT), 15 October 2026 (or before the slots are sold out). ▸ If you wish to change the category, please send your request HERE. Your request will be processed and respond to your email within 7 working days. Kindly keep an eye on your mailbox (include the spam one) during this time. ▸ If you change to a category of a greater value than your original one, you are required to pay the difference of entry fees as it stands at the point of upgrading. ▸ If you change to a category of a lesser value, there is no refund of the difference in entry fees.

|ADMINISTRATION FEE

Administration fee must be paid upon any changes: Upgrade/Downgrade VND 100,000/participant. Transfer VND 300,000/participant.

ⓘ Upgrade/Downgrade/Transfer are not applied for complementary registration.
